milestones.title: Diwali 2018 Smog Crisis
milestones.subtitle: Nocturnal Inversion & Firecrackers
milestones.description: Thermal inversion trapped dense smoke across North India. AQI spiked beyond 450 in Delhi-NCR, Lucknow, and Patna.

milestones.title: Severe Winter Inversion & Fog
milestones.subtitle: Indo-Gangetic Basin Subsidence
milestones.description: Cold surface temperatures and calm winds led to persistent hazardous smog across Punjab, Haryana, and the Gangetic plains.

milestones.title: Monsoon Atmospheric Washout
milestones.subtitle: Widespread Aerosol Wet Deposition
milestones.description: Peak Southwest monsoon rains scrubbed suspended particulate matter, plunging 85% of Indian stations into the 'Good' (<50 AQI) zone.

milestones.title: Post-Harvest Stubble Burning Peak
milestones.subtitle: Over 4,000 Active Farm Fires
milestones.description: Intense post-paddy harvest stubble burning combined with low atmospheric boundary layer, causing an emergency public health crisis (AQI 485+).

milestones.title: Nationwide Lockdown Commences
milestones.subtitle: Transportation & Industrial Halt
milestones.description: India initiated the world's largest lockdown. Ground vehicular traffic plummeted 90%, halting primary primary anthropogenic emissions.

milestones.title: The Great Clean Air Anomaly
milestones.subtitle: Himalayas Visible from Jalandhar
milestones.description: Unprecedented clean air anomaly: NO2 dropped 60%, PM2.5 plummeted 54%. The snowcapped Dhauladhar range became visible from Punjab for the first time in 30 years.

milestones.title: Unlock 1.0 & Southwest Monsoon
milestones.subtitle: Economic Rebound Meets Rains
milestones.description: Pre-monsoon rainfall mitigated emissions as commercial traffic gradually resumed under phased unlock guidelines.
